units.source_text: 于是，我拥抱着红彤彤的篝火，凝视着道子那张在火光映照下忽隐忽现的脸。

en.t: And so I held myself close to the bright red bonfire and gazed at Michiko's face, appearing and disappearing in the firelight.

units.source_text: 在道子的一生中，这样艳丽的容颜，恐怕很难再现第二次了吧。

en.t: In Michiko's whole life, such a radiant beauty would probably never appear a second time.
